overview.description: The School of Business and Commerce at Rathinam focuses on developing future business leaders, entrepreneurs, financial professionals, and management experts through industry-integrated learning, practical exposure, internships, certifications, and experiential education.

The School of Fashion Design at Rathinam combines creativity, technology, sustainability, business, and industry exposure to prepare students for careers in fashion design, apparel production, fashion communication, styling, retail, and luxury industries.

The School of Sports and Health Sciences at Rathinam focuses on physical fitness, sports performance, wellness, rehabilitation, exercise science, nutrition, and healthcare-oriented education. The programs combine scientific knowledge with practical training, industry exposure, and professional certifications.

The School of Media and Performing Arts at Rathinam focuses on creative expression, digital storytelling, journalism, visual communication, film production, performing arts, and media technologies. Students gain hands-on experience through studios, production projects, internships, and industry collaborations.

The School of Liberal Arts and Sciences at Rathinam promotes interdisciplinary learning, critical thinking, scientific inquiry, communication skills, and holistic development. The programs combine foundational knowledge with research, innovation, technology integration, and real-world application.

The School of Applied Biosciences, Food Technology, and Agritech at Rathinam focuses on biotechnology, food innovation, agricultural technology, sustainability, life sciences, and research-driven learning. Students gain practical exposure through laboratories, industry internships, field visits, research projects, and innovation initiatives.

The School of Sustainability and Climate Studies at Rathinam focuses on environmental stewardship, climate resilience, sustainable development, renewable energy, green technologies, and policy-driven solutions. The programs prepare students to address global environmental challenges through interdisciplinary learning, research, innovation, and field-based experiences.

eligibilityUG.description: Candidates must have successfully completed Higher Secondary Education (10+2) or an equivalent qualification from a recognized board.
generalRequirements: Minimum qualifying marks as prescribed by the institution

eligibilityEngineering.description: Applicants for B.E. and B.Tech programs must have completed Higher Secondary Education with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
requirements: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as core subjects
Compliance with applicable engineering admission norms
Participation in counselling processes where applicable

lateralEntry.description: Diploma holders and eligible candidates may apply for direct admission into the second year of selected engineering and professional programs through lateral entry.

counselling.description: Admission counselling assists students in selecting appropriate programs based on academic background, career goals, and eligibility.

educationLoans.description: Students may avail education loans through nationalized banks, private banks, and approved financial institutions subject to eligibility.

rgunat.fullForm: Rathinam Global University National Admission Test (RGUNAT)

purpose.description: RGUNAT is the university's admission and scholarship assessment examination designed to evaluate a candidate's aptitude, analytical ability, academic preparedness, and program suitability for admission into selected undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

undergraduate: Students appearing for or having completed 10+2 from a recognized board.
postgraduate: Graduates or final-year undergraduate students from recognized institutions.
internationalStudents: Eligible international applicants may participate subject to university guidelines.

duration.note: Duration may vary depending on the program and admission cycle.

negativeMarking.description: Negative marking policies may vary by examination cycle. Candidates should verify through the official examination notification.

steps: Fill in personal and academic details.
Pay the application fee if applicable.

examDates.description: RGUNAT examinations are conducted according to the university's admission schedule.
examDates.note: Candidates should refer to the latest admission notification for exact dates.

cutoff.description: RGUNAT does not generally publish a fixed cutoff applicable to all programs.

mockTests.availability: May be provided during admission campaigns or through the admissions portal.

preparationTips: Strengthen English communication and comprehension skills.
Stay updated on current affairs and technology trends.
Attempt mock tests under timed conditions.
Focus on accuracy and time management.
Revise key concepts relevant to the chosen program.
Maintain a consistent study schedule before the examination.

overview.description: Rathinam offers scholarships and financial assistance programs to recognize academic excellence, sports achievements, leadership potential, innovation, and socio-economic diversity. Scholarship opportunities are designed to support deserving students and encourage outstanding performance.

rgunat.name: RGUNAT Scholarship
rgunat.description: Scholarships may be awarded based on performance in the Rathinam Global University National Admission Test (RGUNAT).

merit.name: Academic Merit Scholarship
merit.description: Scholarships awarded to students with outstanding academic performance in qualifying examinations.

sports.name: Sports Excellence Scholarship
sports.description: Financial assistance for students who have demonstrated excellence in sports at district, state, national, or international levels.

specialCategory.description: Special scholarships may be available for specific categories of students depending on institutional policies and annual scholarship announcements.
specialCategory.note: Availability and eligibility may vary by admission year.

international.description: Scholarship opportunities may be available for eligible international students seeking admission to academic programs.

maximumScholarship.description: The maximum scholarship percentage varies depending on scholarship category, student achievement, admission cycle, and university policy.
maximumScholarship.status: Refer to the official scholarship brochure for the current academic year.

renewalCriteria.description: Scholarship continuation is generally based on academic performance, discipline, attendance, and compliance with institutional regulations.

steps.title: Scholarship Evaluation

steps.title: Award Notification
steps.description: Eligible students receive scholarship approval and fee adjustment details.

availability.description: Separate hostel facilities are available for both male and female students. Accommodation is offered subject to seat availability and institutional policies.

capacity.description: Hostel capacity varies across blocks and academic years.
capacity.note: Exact capacity should be verified through the official hostel administration.

roomTypes.description: Room allocation depends on availability, student preference, and hostel regulations.

food.description: Nutritious meals are served through the hostel mess with a focus on hygiene and balanced nutrition.

security.description: Hostels maintain security measures to ensure student safety and well-being.

generalRules: Students must follow hostel regulations and code of conduct.
Respect for fellow residents is mandatory.
Hostel property must be used responsibly.
Disciplinary action may be taken for rule violations.

curfew.description: Curfew timings are established for student safety and hostel discipline.
curfew.note: Exact timings may differ for boys and girls hostels and are determined by hostel administration.

compulsory.description: Hostel accommodation is generally optional unless specified for particular programs or student categories.

laundry.description: Laundry facilities or laundry service support may be available within the hostel premises.

wifi.description: Internet connectivity is available to support academic activities, communication, and online learning.

medicalSupport.description: Basic healthcare assistance and emergency medical support are available for hostel residents.

overview.description: Rathinam provides transportation facilities for students, faculty, and staff through a network of college buses connecting various parts of Coimbatore and surrounding regions. The service is designed to ensure safe, reliable, and convenient daily commuting.

routes.description: Transportation routes are planned based on student demand and geographic coverage.
routes.note: Route availability may vary each academic year.

pickupPoints.description: Students can board buses from designated pickup locations along approved routes.
pickupPoints.note: Actual pickup points are finalized before the commencement of each semester.

morning.description: Buses operate before college hours to ensure timely arrival on campus.

evening.description: Return trips are scheduled after academic sessions and approved student activities.

coverageAreas.description: The transportation network covers major residential and educational zones in and around Coimbatore.

safetyMeasures.description: Student safety is prioritized through operational and monitoring measures.

contact.description: Students can contact the transport office for route allocation, fee details, pickup point information, and transportation support.
contact.note: Latest contact numbers and route coordinators should be verified through the official transport office.

overview.description: Rathinam provides a variety of dining options through its cafeteria, food courts, hostel mess facilities, and refreshment centers. The food ecosystem is designed to cater to students, faculty, staff, and visitors with a focus on nutrition, affordability, convenience, and hygiene.

cafeteria.description: The campus cafeteria serves a wide range of meals, snacks, beverages, and quick-service food items throughout the academic day.

foodQuality.description: Food preparation focuses on nutrition, taste, freshness, and quality standards suitable for a student community.

vegOptions.description: A wide range of vegetarian meals and snacks are available across dining facilities.

nonVegOptions.description: Non-vegetarian meal options may be available through designated dining services and hostel mess facilities based on institutional policy.

cafeteria.weekdays: Typically operates from morning until evening.
cafeteria.weekends: Limited or scheduled operation depending on academic activities.

operatingHours.note: Actual timings may vary by semester and operational requirements.

foodCourts.description: Food court areas provide students with multiple dining choices and informal gathering spaces.

specialMenus.description: Special menus may be introduced during festivals, celebrations, cultural events, and important campus occasions.

hygieneStandards.description: Food preparation and serving processes follow hygiene and safety practices to maintain student health and well-being.

overview.description: Student life at Rathinam extends beyond academics and focuses on holistic development through clubs, communities, leadership opportunities, innovation programs, sports, cultural activities, volunteering, and entrepreneurship. The campus encourages students to explore their interests, develop professional skills, and build meaningful connections.

clubs.description: Students can participate in various technical, cultural, professional, creative, and social clubs based on their interests and career aspirations.

communities.description: Student communities bring together individuals with shared interests, goals, and passions to foster collaboration and peer learning.

culturalActivities.description: Cultural engagement plays a significant role in campus life through festivals, performances, competitions, and celebrations.

sportsActivities.description: Sports and fitness activities promote physical well-being, discipline, teamwork, and competitive spirit.

leadershipPrograms.description: Leadership development programs help students cultivate management, communication, decision-making, and organizational skills.

volunteering.description: Students are encouraged to contribute to society through volunteering and service-learning activities.

socialInitiatives.description: The institution supports initiatives that address societal challenges and encourage positive social impact.

entrepreneurship.description: Entrepreneurship is strongly encouraged through innovation programs, startup incubation, mentorship, and business development support.

overview.description: Student clubs at Rathinam provide opportunities for leadership, networking, creativity, innovation, social engagement, and skill development. Clubs are student-driven and supported by faculty mentors and industry experts.

technical.description: Technical clubs help students strengthen their domain knowledge and practical skills through workshops, competitions, and projects.

cultural.description: Cultural clubs celebrate creativity, diversity, and artistic expression.

sports.description: Sports clubs encourage physical fitness, teamwork, discipline, and competitive excellence.

entrepreneurship.description: Entrepreneurship clubs support startup culture and innovation through mentoring and business-building activities.

socialImpact.description: Social impact clubs focus on community service, awareness campaigns, and sustainable development initiatives.

robotics.description: Robotics clubs provide hands-on experience in automation, electronics, embedded systems, and intelligent systems.

coding.description: Coding clubs help students improve programming, problem-solving, and software development skills.

gdsc.name: Google Developer Student Club (GDSC)
gdsc.description: A student developer community focused on Google technologies, app development, cloud computing, AI, and professional growth.

ieee.name: IEEE Student Chapter
ieee.description: IEEE activities promote technical excellence, research, innovation, and professional networking in engineering and technology domains.

media.description: Media clubs enable students to explore content creation, journalism, video production, and digital communication.

photography.description: Photography clubs help students develop visual storytelling and creative photography skills.

music.description: Music clubs nurture vocal and instrumental talents while promoting artistic collaboration.

dance.description: Dance clubs provide a platform for students to learn and perform various dance styles.

drama.description: Drama clubs focus on theatre arts, acting, scriptwriting, and stage production.

literary.description: Literary clubs encourage reading, writing, public speaking, and communication skills.

nss.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
nss.description: NSS encourages students to participate in community development and social service activities.

ncc.name: National Cadet Corps (NCC)
ncc.description: NCC develops discipline, leadership, patriotism, and national service values among students.

overview.description: Rathinam hosts a wide range of academic, technical, cultural, entrepreneurial, sports, and industry-focused events throughout the academic year. These events provide students with opportunities to learn, network, compete, showcase talent, and gain industry exposure.

annualFest.description: The annual fest serves as one of the largest campus celebrations, bringing together students, alumni, faculty, industry guests, and participants from various institutions.

culturalFest.description: Cultural festivals celebrate creativity, diversity, and artistic talent through performances and competitions.

techFest.description: Technical festivals provide a platform for innovation, engineering excellence, coding skills, and emerging technologies.

sportsFest.description: Sports festivals encourage physical fitness, teamwork, and competitive excellence among students.

hackathons.description: Hackathons challenge students to solve real-world problems through innovation and technology.

workshops.description: Workshops provide practical training and hands-on experience in academic, technical, and professional domains.

bootcamps.description: Intensive bootcamps help students acquire specialized skills within a short period.

competitions.description: Students regularly participate in academic, technical, creative, and entrepreneurial competitions.

industrySummits.description: Industry summits connect students with corporate leaders, entrepreneurs, investors, and technology experts.

conferences.description: Academic and professional conferences encourage knowledge sharing, research dissemination, and networking.

guestLectures.description: Experts from academia, industry, government, and startups regularly interact with students through guest lectures.

clubEvents.description: Student clubs organize regular events, competitions, workshops, networking sessions, and celebrations.

internationalEvents.description: International events provide global exposure through collaborations, competitions, and cultural exchange activities.

celebrityVisits.description: The institution periodically hosts renowned personalities from entertainment, sports, entrepreneurship, academia, and industry.

overview.description: Rathinam promotes a student-centric, innovation-driven, and industry-oriented culture that emphasizes academic excellence, personal growth, leadership, social responsibility, and professional development. The campus environment encourages students to learn, collaborate, innovate, and contribute meaningfully to society.

diversity.description: The campus brings together students from diverse geographical, academic, linguistic, and cultural backgrounds, creating a rich learning environment.

inclusiveness.description: The institution strives to create an environment where every student feels respected, valued, and supported regardless of background or discipline.

discipline.description: Discipline is viewed as an essential component of academic success and professional development.

studentTeacherRelationship.description: Faculty members serve as educators, mentors, guides, and career advisors, fostering meaningful relationships with students.

workEthic.description: Students are encouraged to develop a strong work ethic through consistent effort, accountability, continuous learning, and professional behavior.

collaboration.description: Collaboration is integrated into academic, extracurricular, entrepreneurial, and research activities across the institution.

community.description: The Rathinam community consists of students, faculty, alumni, industry partners, entrepreneurs, researchers, and support staff working together to create a vibrant learning ecosystem.

overview.description: Innovation is a key pillar of the Rathinam ecosystem. The institution promotes creativity, problem-solving, entrepreneurship, applied research, and technology-driven solutions through incubation centers, innovation labs, startup programs, research initiatives, and industry collaborations.

aicRaise.name: AIC RAISE
aicRaise.fullForm: Atal Incubation Centre - Rathinam Innovation and Startup Ecosystem
aicRaise.description: AIC RAISE serves as a startup incubation and innovation platform that supports entrepreneurs, startups, researchers, and innovators in transforming ideas into scalable ventures.

ideaLab.description: The Idea Lab provides students and innovators with a space to experiment, prototype, design, and validate innovative concepts.

incubationCenter.description: The incubation center supports startup founders and innovators throughout the venture development lifecycle.

startups.description: The innovation ecosystem encourages the creation and growth of startups across multiple sectors.

studentStartups.description: Students are encouraged to launch and develop startups while pursuing their academic programs.

fundingSupport.description: Eligible startups and innovation projects may receive funding support through incubation programs, investors, grants, competitions, and government initiatives.

patents.description: Students and faculty are encouraged to engage in intellectual property creation and patent filing activities.

researchCenters.description: Research centers facilitate interdisciplinary research, innovation, and industry collaboration in emerging and applied domains.

overview.description: Rathinam promotes global learning through international collaborations, academic partnerships, exchange opportunities, cross-cultural experiences, global immersion programs, and international industry exposure. The objective is to develop globally competent graduates capable of succeeding in diverse international environments.

globalImmersion.description: Global immersion programs provide students with exposure to international academic systems, industries, cultures, and innovation ecosystems.

exchangePrograms.description: Student exchange programs offer opportunities to study at partner institutions for a semester, short-term program, or specialized academic experience.

partnerUniversities.description: Rathinam seeks collaborations with international universities and institutions to strengthen global learning opportunities.
partnerUniversities.note: Specific partner universities may change over time and should be verified through the International Relations Office.

internationalInternships.description: Students may have opportunities to participate in internships with international companies, startups, research organizations, and partner institutions.

studyAbroadSupport.description: The institution provides guidance and support for students interested in pursuing higher education or academic experiences abroad.

internships.description: Internships are integrated into the academic framework to provide industry exposure and practical experience.

trainingPrograms.description: Structured training programs are conducted to enhance employability and professional readiness.

successStories.description: Students and alumni have secured opportunities in leading organizations, startups, higher education institutions, and entrepreneurial ventures.

Alumni founding startups and entrepreneurial ventures.
Graduates pursuing higher education at reputed institutions.
Students winning national innovation and startup competitions.

overview.description: Rathinam's faculty comprises academicians, researchers, industry professionals, innovators, and mentors who contribute to teaching, research, industry collaboration, entrepreneurship development, and student success. Faculty members play a central role in delivering outcome-based and industry-integrated education.

count.description: Faculty strength varies across departments, schools, and academic programs.
count.status: Dynamic and subject to annual recruitment and expansion.
count.note: Refer to the official institution profile for the latest faculty count.

phdPercentage.description: A significant proportion of faculty members possess doctoral qualifications or are actively pursuing doctoral research.
phdPercentage.note: Exact percentage should be verified through official institutional reports.

industryExperts.description: Industry practitioners and domain experts contribute to academic delivery, mentorship, workshops, internships, and industry-integrated learning.

studentFacultyRatio.description: The institution aims to maintain a healthy student-faculty ratio to encourage personalized learning, mentoring, and academic support.
studentFacultyRatio.note: Actual ratio may vary by department and academic year.

researchPublications.description: Faculty members actively contribute to scholarly research through publications, conferences, patents, and collaborative research projects.

achievements.description: Faculty achievements span teaching excellence, research contributions, innovation, consulting, entrepreneurship, and professional recognition.
highlights: Participation in national and international conferences.
Mentoring student innovation and startup initiatives.
Contribution to curriculum development and academic excellence.

overview.description: Rathinam's alumni network consists of graduates working across technology, business, finance, media, entrepreneurship, research, education, healthcare, and public service sectors. Alumni contribute to the institution through mentoring, recruitment, networking, industry interaction, and knowledge sharing.

notableAlumni.description: Rathinam alumni have built successful careers in multinational corporations, startups, entrepreneurship, academia, media, and leadership positions across various industries.
notableAlumni.note: Specific notable alumni profiles should be sourced from official alumni records and institutional publications.

successStories.description: Alumni success stories reflect achievements across professional careers, entrepreneurship, higher education, innovation, and social impact.

examples.story: Graduates securing positions in leading technology companies and global IT organizations.
Alumni founding startups and building successful business ventures across multiple sectors.
Graduates pursuing advanced studies and research at reputed national and international institutions.
Alumni progressing into managerial and leadership roles within their industries.
Former students contributing to research, product innovation, and technology development.

globalNetwork.description: The alumni community extends across India and international locations, creating opportunities for networking, mentorship, and collaboration.

entrepreneurs.description: Many alumni have pursued entrepreneurship and contributed to innovation ecosystems through startups, business ventures, and social enterprises.
